qualification: local A05.3 reliability isolation; not A05.3 closure, cross-host, G1-G5, or release qualification

candidate.scope: Make recorded native-trace batch replay independently selectable on an executor and disable it for the production PC machine while leaving ordinary generated execution, direct chaining, IBTC, shadow returns, Tier-one admission, and mixed-compiler rejection unchanged.
candidate.behavioralIntent: Determine whether the alternate callback-free C batch-call boundary was the source of the layout-sensitive guest corruption and invalid generated returns.
candidate.regressionCoverage: A trace-off directed chain completed cold and warm with zero batch executions, attempts, and replays; the original trace-on replay test remained green. The focused gate passed 36 tests in two suites and the deterministic aggregate passed 1,556 tests in 179 suites.
candidate.productionFinding: The first exact-binary run passed all seven workloads and powered off with trace attempts and replays both zero. The second run of the identical binary crashed before a receipt with PC, LR, and FP all zero. Recorded native-trace replay is therefore not the sole source of the reliability defect and disabling it cannot be accepted as containment.

verification.deterministicAggregate: 1,556 tests in 179 suites passed with test parallelism disabled.

retainedBaseline.reason: The behavior-neutral coarse instrumentation remains the last production-safe measurement.

disposition.reason: The candidate is fully reverted. One success cannot override an identical-binary null-control-flow crash. The defect also occurs without native batch replay, so future isolation must cover the ordinary generated call and raw chain/predictor paths.

limitations: The failed run produced no receipt, so guest progress, counters, elapsed time, and workload status are unavailable and are not inferred.
The crash report establishes null host control state but does not identify which ordinary generated edge or stack write first corrupted it.
The passing run's 51.07-percent avoidance is not accepted performance evidence because the identical candidate failed reliability.
